title: nan
authors: Dehbi M.; Tiali M.A.B.; Lachachi Y.; Ayaida M.; El Hillali Y.; Rivenq A.
key_contribution: Presents a novel localization framework fusing reflective QR codes, LiDAR, dead reckoning, and V2X communication for GPS-denied vehicle navigation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
